root: ^You! The little lady from before, it's all your fault!
^Oh I'm going to be so late... What time is it?
^There's no watch, no watch at all!
^Miss, you better help me find it, or we all are going to be late!
^Oh, The Queen hates when we are late... I'm going to lose my head, no time, no time...!
^Please do not lose your head, mister! I'll help you find it.
